_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Tokko Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Jalqaba {start_chips} chip
• Deck kaartii tokko 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Gocha player vs dealer (mana)
• Round tokko tokko Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure qaba: ANTE fi BLIND bets godhu, 2 kaartii argattu, PLAY bets optional godhu, kaartii community argattu, fi kaartii 5-sararaa player vs dealer mijaawu. Goal kee maximizii winnings (yoo kaartii sirrii qabda), fi minimize loss (yoo kaartii doofaa qabda).
• Game dhumessa yoo chip kee 0 ykn gadii jalqaba round (LOSS) ykn 1000 round guutuu chip kee (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet round tokko
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet round tokko
• PLAY: Optional bet gameplay keessatti. Round keessatti, tokko tokko godhu: (${ante4} yoo PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} yoo FLOP, ykn ${ante} yoo RIVER. Yoo kaartii river, fold godhu, fi bet hin godhin.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• 2 kaartii argattu (kaartii kee)
• Dealer 2 kaartii argattu (hidden keessan)
• 5 kaartii community argattu face-down jalqaba
• Kaartii community progressive godhu phase keessatti

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer kaartii PAIR (2 kaartii sirrii) qabu, 2 kaartii fi 5 kaartii community.
• Dealer qualification betting outcomes affect, as will be explained later.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) ykn [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, reveals first 3 kaartii community
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveals first 3 kaartii community

📋 FLOP:
  • Yoo 4x bet godhe: Only [skip] available (auto-reveals last 2 kaartii community)
  • Yoo 4x bet hin godhin: [2x] (${ante2}) ykn [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, reveals last 2 kaartii community
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveals last 2 kaartii community

📋 RIVER:
  • Yoo 4x ykn 2x bet godhe: Only [skip] available (auto-proceeds showdown)
  • Yoo PLAY bet hin godhin: [1x] (${ante}) ykn [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, proceeds showdown
  • [fold]: Give up kaartii, lose ANTE fi BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kaartii hundi argattu fi evaluated
  • Best 5-sararaa kaartii 7 kaartii (2 kaartii + 5 kaartii community)
  • Bets settled according payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer doesn't qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualifies & you win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualifies & you lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected dealer qualification
  • You win: Bet returned fi additional payout based hand strength
  • You lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Your best hand vs Dealer's best hand
  • You win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • You lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 of same suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive cards of same suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 cards of same rank
  4. Full House: 3 of a kind + 2 of a kind
  5. Flush: 5 cards of same suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive cards
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 cards of same rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs of different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 cards of same rank
  10. High Card: Highest card wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] ykn [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] ykn [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] ykn [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] ykn [c]: Check (no additional bet)
• [fold] ykn [f]: Fold (give up kaartii)
• [skip] ykn [s]: Skip to next phase (when no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high cards) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push if dealer doesn't qualify
• BLIND bet can be very profitable with strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch your chip stack! If it goes to 0 or below at start of round, you lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE fi BLIND bets are mandatory every round
• PLAY bets are optional fi strategic
• Make sure you input the correct action, fi only one action at a time.
